versions.name: Model Design and Building
versions.description: Draw plans to scale and build an original model - a house, a framed corner, a plumbing run, a machine, or a vehicle - then design a fantasy spacecraft from real aircraft and ship references.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
